dossiers.label: The angler: a model division
dossiers.about: Before hunting the sophist, the Stranger practises on something small and familiar: the angler. All arts are cut in two, production and acquisition, and the right-hand part is cut again and again until angling is reached; then the steps are read back as a definition, and the sophist is sought on the same model.

passage.end_quote: κατὰ τοῦτο τὸ παράδειγμα καὶ τὸν σοφιστὴν ἐπιχειρῶμεν εὑρεῖν

dossiers.label: The battle of gods and giants over being
dossiers.about: A battle like the gods' war with the giants: materialists drag everything down from heaven to earth, grasping rocks and trees, while the friends of the forms defend bodiless forms from on high. The Stranger offers a mark of being to both: being is nothing but power, to act or be acted on.

passage.start_quote: τοὺς δὲ ἄλλως λέγοντας αὖ θεατέον
passage.end_quote: τὸ ὄν τε καὶ τὸ πᾶν συναμφότερα λέγειν

related.why: Being, rest and change, the first three of the greatest kinds, come out of this battle.

evidence.quote: τό τε ὂν αὐτὸ καὶ στάσις καὶ κίνησις

dossiers.label: The greatest kinds and not-being
dossiers.about: Being, rest and change, then same and different: five kinds which blend with one another in some ways and not others. Not-being turns out to be not the opposite of being but the different; so false statement is possible, and Parmenides' command is defied: 'Theaetetus sits', 'Theaetetus flies'.

passage.start_quote: τὰ μὲν ἡμῖν τῶν γενῶν ὡμολόγηται κοινωνεῖν ἐθέλειν ἀλλήλοις
